case_result.notes: The fresh ChatGPT Web result identified CodexGPT as a Windows-first self-hosted MCP local-development bridge, named scripts/codexgpt-entry.mjs as the supported public CLI, identified src/stdio.ts and src/http.ts plus their built/bin entry points, and correctly prioritized npm run connect for normal source-checkout use. It explicitly reported reusing ws_b7ea7abb9d1b518608670427840f00b3 for all follow-up reads, no WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND, and only three necessary file reads after open_workspace. The connector surface does not expose the MCP transport/session identifier, so transport_rotation_observed remains null rather than inferred. The earlier same-runtime current-conversation probe independently proved the first explicit package.json read was bound to the pinned target and not the profile/default root by exact root and SHA-256 comparison.
